protocol.scale: 0-5 integer with optional .5 only when evidence is mixed inside a single dimension

anchors.0: Absent or actively unreadable. The dimension cannot function.
anchors.1: Amateur or broken. Frequent failures that would stop a serial reader.
anchors.2: Below professional serial standard. Occasional readable beats, but the dimension would not survive platform editorial.
anchors.3: Competent and functional. A working serial, but not competitive with the owner's named reference bar.
anchors.4: Strong professional serial. Would not embarrass a mid-tier licensed platform title on this dimension.
anchors.5: Competitive with the high-level transferable craft of the owner's named bar (Tower of God, Solo Leveling) without imitating those titles.

rules: Do not calculate a single total until every category is scored.
Copyrighted comparables: score only dimensions supportable from licensed public samples and cited analysis; otherwise mark not_assessed.
Owner rejection outranks internal rubric scores.
File integrity, hash continuity, and schema PASS do not raise sequential-art scores.
Each score must cite evidence paths. Inference must be labeled.
Reviewer A and Reviewer B must not see each other's scores before writing.
Disagreement of 2 or more points on any dimension is preserved, not averaged away.

weights.note: Weights may support, not replace, diagnosis. Applied only after all category results are visible.
